name: Etapp 11: Gimo / Gimo herrgård to Österbybruk / Österbybruks bruksmiljö
utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include rest area, shelter, fireplace, swimming, toilet, campsite, water, heritage, attraction, rule warning, parking, transit.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Use GPX track 1 as the main Etapp 11 route.
Do not concatenate the short 45 m track 2 after track 1.
Do not split the reviewed Glamsmossen 525.2 m generalized segment solely because it exceeds 500 m; preserve as continuous official geometry or densify if importer requires max-step compliance.
Iteration 2 rechecked current Naturkartan, Upplandsstiftelsen and Roslagen pages: no active 2025-10-01 route-condition warning was visible; only the Aspbo non-potable-water warning remains active.
Iteration 3 found no active route closure/reroute warning on Naturkartan/API, Upplandsstiftelsen or Roslagen; active warning remains Aspbo non-potable water.

facilities.name: Glamsmossen peat extraction area and log-floating channel
facilities.description: Iteration 4: no authoritative discrete POI coordinate found for peat barns, peat works or channel signage. Official and older Upplandsleden/Florarna text corroborates peat extraction at Glamsmossen and the flottningskanal after Kakeläng. OSM way 705680867 is a strong mapped canal-line candidate aligned with the route, and OSM way 1437070426 corroborates the former Gubbo peat-factory industrial spur, but these are line/context features rather than importable point attractions. Keep as narrative/context only; suppress normal point import unless line-geometry context is supported. Promoted during Upplandsleden normalization from a pending row under the current app policy.
